package.description: Mount a Slogs Obsidian remote vault as a WinFsp-backed Windows drive.

en-US.description: Mount a Slogs Obsidian remote vault as a WinFsp-backed Windows drive.
en-US.longDescription: Slogs Obsidian Drive mounts a Slogs Obsidian remote vault as a local Windows drive using WinFsp. The installer is a NativeAOT executable and installs WinFsp 2.2.26112 from the official WinFsp GitHub release when WinFsp is missing.
